identity.title: Current Public Execution Feasibility Core
identity.objective: Implement the V2.1 generic current public execution-feasibility capability: bind one exact StrategyVersion read-only, build a content-addressed ExecutionIntent, acquire bounded current public Gamma market and CLOB book evidence through exactly two fixed-host unauthenticated GETs into a content-addressed PublicExecutionVenueSnapshot, and deterministically evaluate venue mechanics into a content-addressed ExecutionFeasibilityAssessment (FEASIBLE / LIMITED / INCONCLUSIVE / NOT_FEASIBLE); no persistence, account state, Gate-C, order, execution or live authority; not WP172 executable edge.

scope.rollback_surface: Revert the exact S10-EXEC-FEAS-01 diff. The src/execution_feasibility package, its focused test, the contract, status fragment, package artifacts, the single architecture-boundary family approval and the doc reconciliation disappear; no store, schema, runtime state, dependency, workflow, account, order or capital state exists to roll back.

items.required_rule: Builder input is an exact StrategyVersion revalidated by record_from_mapping(RECORD_KIND, to_mapping()) == record, never mutated or written; execution_rule_sha256 = executionrule:sha256: + sha256(canonical_json({execution_rule})) always derived

Closed sides/styles/order types; AGGRESSIVE_TAKER uses FOK/FAK with post_only false and no expiration; PASSIVE_MAKER uses GTC/GTD with post_only true; GTD expiration >= floor(cutoff_ns/1e9)+180; shares > 0; 0 < price_limit < 1; 0 < max age <= 60 s; canonical decimal strings only; venue ids digits/0x-hex bounded

At most two HTTPS GETs per acquisition (Gamma market then CLOB book) to exactly two fixed hosts, default port, no redirects, no retries, no sleep, no cookies or credential headers, no proxy discovery, 5 s timeout, capped reads (cap+1 sentinel, Content-Length pre-rejection)
Transport/HTTP failure -> UNAVAILABLE; body/shape/schema/size/identity violation -> INVALID; unavailable or invalid facts stay null; no upstream text echoed

Gamma id/condition/token membership and CLOB market/asset must match exactly or the source is INVALID with SOURCE_IDENTITY_MISMATCH; tick, minimum-order and negRisk cross-source conflicts are UNKNOWN (INCONCLUSIVE)
Bids normalized descending and asks ascending regardless of wire order; 0 < price < 1, size > 0, unique prices, <= 5,000 levels per side, no crossed book; one-sided books valid
book_timestamp_ns (ms -> ns) must be <= acquisition completion and within max_public_data_age_ns; HTTP duration is never market latency evidence
Known active false, closed true, acceptingOrders false or enableOrderBook false is FAIL/NOT_FEASIBLE; missing state UNKNOWN; restricted recorded only
Exact Decimal price_limit % reconciled tick == 0; off-grid FAIL PRICE_OFF_TICK; never by decimal-place count
requested_shares * price_limit compared with Gamma orderMinSize as minimum USDC notional; CLOB min_order_size never relabelled as shares

Visible opposing levels within the price bound only; FOK short -> NOT_FEASIBLE; FAK zero -> NOT_FEASIBLE; FAK partial -> LIMITED; slippage vs best ask/bid; depth metrics are market depth only; division-derived values quantized conservatively at 18 dp
Post-only BUY >= best ask or SELL <= best bid would cross -> NOT_FEASIBLE; empty opposite side may rest; passive fill UNKNOWN/null

Fees disabled -> EXACT_ZERO_NO_FEES; passive + takerOnly -> EXACT_ZERO_MAKER; aggressive taker -> per-level exact sum of shares*rate*(p(1-p))**e for integer e in 0..8 with five-decimal ceiling CONSERVATIVE_5DP_UPPER_BOUND; otherwise UNKNOWN; expected maker rebate always null
Aggressive secondsDelay 0 PASS, >0 LIMITED MARKETABLE_ORDER_DELAY, missing UNKNOWN; passive NOT_APPLICABLE; client latency always UNKNOWN/null
adverse_selection_state UNKNOWN with null cost and passive fill UNKNOWN/null are visible limitations, never zero, and do not alone change status
Every dimension populated; any FAIL -> NOT_FEASIBLE; else any UNKNOWN -> INCONCLUSIVE; else V1 limitation -> LIMITED; else FEASIBLE
Three records validated by exact type, schema, closed loader, bounds and re-derived content id; evaluated_at_ns >= acquisition completion; full re-evaluation validator
No credential, account, order, signing, Gate-C, execution-gateway, paper, persistence, scheduler or live path; import has zero side effects; authority booleans invariant true
No profitability, edge, PnL or account capacity; not WP172; EXECUTABLE_EDGE_PASS untouched

items.expected_result: importing src.execution_feasibility in a fresh interpreter records zero socket, subprocess, sqlite, file-write or environment-write audit events and starts no thread

the four source files contain no SecureClient, credential, environment, order, signing, execution-gateway, paper, sqlite, threading, asyncio, sleep or WP172 term and import only the frozen stdlib/STRAT-LIFE set; only public_market.py reads the clock
the package exports exactly the frozen small API with no order, sign, cancel, store, persist, write, cache or raw transport name
a valid StrategyVersion binds its id into the intent, validates with the binding check and is never mutated
a tampered, mapping-typed or missing StrategyVersion rejects STRATEGY_VERSION_INVALID
execution_rule_sha256 equals executionrule:sha256: + sha256(canonical {execution_rule}) and changes only with the execution rule
the builder accepts no digest argument and a substituted or mismatched digest rejects EXECUTION_RULE_BINDING_INVALID
FOK and FAK aggressive intents for BUY and SELL build with post_only false, no expiration and invariant authority flags
post-only GTC and GTD passive intents build; GTD at exactly cutoff + 180 s is accepted
aggressive GTC/GTD, passive FOK/FAK and out-of-vocabulary side/style/order values reject FIELD_VALUE_INVALID
aggressive post_only true and passive post_only false reject; a non-bool post_only rejects FIELD_TYPE_INVALID
GTC with expiration, GTD missing or under 180 s, boolean expiration and aggressive expiration reject
float, NaN, exponent, signed, padded and over-precision decimal text reject for price and shares
signed, whitespace, overlong, non-digit, uppercase, truncated and URL-like venue ids reject
zero/negative shares, price outside (0,1), age outside (0, 60 s] and negative cutoff reject while the 60 s age bound is accepted
one acquisition performs exactly two GETs, Gamma then CLOB, to the exact fixed URLs with 5 s timeout and only an Accept header
http, foreign host, non-default port, userinfo, suffix-spoofed host and non-GET methods raise the closed network codes with zero opener calls
the no-redirect handler raises on every redirect, the default opener installs it, and redirect responses become UNAVAILABLE without a follow-up request or body read
transport errors and HTTP 404/429/500/503 produce exactly two requests and UNAVAILABLE states with no retry
an oversize Content-Length is rejected before any read, the body is read with cap + 1 and a sentinel byte yields OVERSIZE -> INVALID with null payload hash
upstream exception text and response values never appear in records or exception strings, which are closed codes only
Gamma UNAVAILABLE keeps every Gamma fact null and the assessment INCONCLUSIVE with SOURCE_GAMMA_UNAVAILABLE
CLOB UNAVAILABLE keeps book facts null/empty and book/fill dimensions UNKNOWN
truncated, non-UTF-8, duplicate-key, NaN, too-deep and wrongly typed bodies become INVALID with the raw-body hash recorded
Gamma identity matches and the token is accepted whether clobTokenIds is a JSON string or a list
Gamma id/condition/token and CLOB market/asset mismatches become INVALID with SOURCE_IDENTITY_MISMATCH and the evaluator refuses a cross-token intent
a Gamma/CLOB tick conflict or a missing tick source makes the tick dimension UNKNOWN and the status INCONCLUSIVE
a Gamma/CLOB minimum-order conflict makes the minimum-order dimension UNKNOWN and records MIN_ORDER_SOURCE_CONFLICT
a negRisk conflict is INCONCLUSIVE while agreeing negRisk true stays FEASIBLE
raw ascending bids and descending asks normalize to best-first order regardless of wire order
duplicate prices, prices outside (0,1), non-positive or non-numeric sizes and extra level keys make the CLOB source INVALID with BOOK_INVALID
a crossed or locked book is INVALID at acquisition and rejected by the snapshot validator
empty-bid, empty-ask and empty books are AVAILABLE and yield null best prices
5,000 levels per side normalize, 5,001 reject, and a book too large for the bounded record becomes INVALID
millisecond timestamps normalize to ns, future timestamps are BOOK_TIMESTAMP_INVALID and age over the bound is BOOK_STALE, both INCONCLUSIVE
inactive, closed, not-accepting and order-book-disabled markets are NOT_FEASIBLE with closed diagnostics; restricted alone is recorded only
each missing or null required market state makes the market dimension UNKNOWN and the status INCONCLUSIVE
ticks 0.01, 0.005, 0.0025, 0.001 and 0.0001 accept on-grid and reject off-grid prices by exact modulo with PRICE_OFF_TICK
exact USDC-notional equality passes, below-minimum is NOT_FEASIBLE and a missing Gamma minimum is never inferred from CLOB
a BUY ask sweep reports exact best prices, spread, fill, ratio, VWAP, slippage and visible/price-bound depth
FOK insufficient depth is NOT_FEASIBLE, FAK partial is LIMITED with floored ratio and no reachable asks is NOT_FEASIBLE
SELL sweeps bids descending with conservative floored VWAP, slippage and FAK/FOK outcomes
non-crossing post-only orders rest FEASIBLE with passive fill UNKNOWN/null, crossing ones are NOT_FEASIBLE and an empty opposite side can rest
disabled fees are EXACT_ZERO_NO_FEES and taker-only passive makers EXACT_ZERO_MAKER with the rebate rate informational
taker fees are summed per fill level (not from VWAP) for exponents 0, 1 and 2 with a five-decimal ceiling upper bound
unsupported/fractional exponents, non-taker-only, malformed or missing schedules and unknown feesEnabled are UNKNOWN and INCONCLUSIVE
expected_maker_rebate_usd is always null and a populated value rejects
aggressive zero delay is PASS, positive delay LIMITED, missing delay INCONCLUSIVE and passive delay NOT_APPLICABLE
client latency is UNKNOWN/null regardless of HTTP duration
adverse selection is UNKNOWN with null cost in every assessment and a zero cost rejects
hard FAIL beats required UNKNOWN beats LIMITED beats FEASIBLE across closed+missing-fee, partial+missing-fee and partial+known-fee cases
the intent round-trips and forged ids, wrong prefixes, changed or dropped fields, extra fields and false authority flags reject
the snapshot round-trips and forged ids, wrong prefixes, changed or dropped fields, extra fields and false authority flags reject
the assessment round-trips and forged ids, prefixes, fields, statuses and schema versions reject
evaluation before acquisition completion, boolean time and mapping-typed inputs reject
the assessment is deterministic and revalidates only against its exact intent and snapshot
canonical JSON sorts keys with UTF-8, rejects floats/NaN/non-string keys/over-depth values and canonical decimals drop exponents and redundant zeros
every spec example is a product-built record whose id the unchanged guard derivation reproduces and whose modified or dropped identity field is detected
the spec scope is exactly 17 paths outside STRAT-LIFE, execution, paper, data-layer, tools, workflow, local data and dependency surfaces with the frozen authority booleans
the package references no EXECUTABLE_EDGE_PASS, executable_edge, queue multiplier or profitability field
src/execution_feasibility is the single new approved family with exactly four files and no wildcard
docs record HERMES-STRAT merged and EXEC-FEAS as current public mechanics distinct from WP172
the known-candidate path records EXEC-FEAS current and GATE-C-EXPLORE next not started with ALPHA-03 parallel
project status makes EXEC-FEAS the current implemented review target with GATE-C-EXPLORE next not started
repo truth records the four-file package with no persistence, account, order or live authority
